experience.title: Knowledge & Academic Background
experience.description: Beyond writing code, my time studying computer science and engineering gave me a comprehensive understanding of requirements, data structures, and best practices such as Clean Architecture and DDD. This comprehensive perspective guides my professional career, combining accessible prototyping with modular full-stack development, ranging from native and cross-platform mobile applications to asynchronous processing pipelines. It has also allowed me to gain experience with various tools that facilitate teamwork, such as agile methodologies.

fullstack.title: Full-Stack Developer (Web, Mobile & Cloud)
fullstack.subtitle: Independent & AI Alpha Analytics
fullstack.description: Provision of autonomous services in full stack web development using React, Vue 3, Node.js, TypeScript, NestJS, and Python (Flask/FastAPI). Cross-platform mobile app development with Flutter/Dart. Cloud platform configuration, architecture, and deployment via Amazon Web Services (AWS): S3, Amplify. Relational and non-relational database modeling and implementation (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB), ensuring transactional integrity and query optimization.

Design of corporate graphic material, visual and promotional identity for events and CR2 UV robotics competitions.

projects.title: Featured projects
projects.description: Within the process of growing my professional career, I can not only show you my work experience, but I must also show you the projects that I have developed in my free time or as part of my training as a professional.

Svalinn.title: Svalinn Cybersecurity Landing Page
Svalinn.description: Svalinn is a cybersecurity company that offers consulting services and security solutions for businesses. The project consisted of designing and developing the company's landing page, ensuring an intuitive and accessible user experience.

AI Alpha Analytics.title: AI Alpha Analytics Landing Page and Brand Identity
AI Alpha Analytics.description: AI Alpha Analytics is a technology company specialized in developing advanced AI-driven solutions aimed at addressing complex challenges and enhancing efficiency in the healthcare and digital rehabilitation sectors. The project involved designing and developing the company's landing page, along with creating its brand identity, logos, and brand manual, ensuring an intuitive and accessible user experience.

AgileFlow UV.title: AgileFlow UV
AgileFlow UV.description: AgileFlow UV is a framework that allows students from the University of Valparaíso (UV) to implement agile methodologies in their semester projects. The project involved designing, implementing, and validating this framework, ensuring that teams can manage their projects efficiently and collaboratively in educational environments.

Eliza's Memories.title: Eliza's Memories
Eliza's Memories.description: Interactive visual novel and narrative adventure that takes players through the memories and correspondence of Elizabeth Schuyler Hamilton. Set in temporal jumps from the revolutionary camps of 1780 to mid-19th century New York. A demo developed to familiarize myself with game development and interactive storytelling.

Turin!.title: Turin! | Interior Tourism
Turin!.description: Multi-platform mobile application developed with Flutter, designed to provide users with an interactive and personalized tourism experience. The project is still in development but focuses on offering detailed information about tourist destinations, activities, and local services, with an emphasis on accessibility and usability.

Portfolio.title: Personal Portfolio
Portfolio.description: Personal portfolio developed with Angular, designed to showcase projects, experience, and skills in a clear and attractive manner. The project includes interactive sections and a responsive design that adapts to different devices.

fullStack.title: FullStack development
fullStack.description: Building complete and maintainable web applications. Developing reactive interfaces in React, Vue 3, and Angular, backed by robust services in Node.js, NestJS, and Python, with optimized databases and clean architectures.

mobile.title: Mobile development
mobile.description: Creating smooth and cross-platform applications with Flutter, complemented by native development in Kotlin. I apply design patterns such as BLOC and principles of Clean Architecture to ensure stability and efficient persistence.

design.title: From design to deployment
design.description: A comprehensive approach to the product lifecycle: interactive prototyping in Figma under accessibility criteria (WCAG), agile workflows (Scrum / Kanban), and continuous deployment in the cloud with AWS and Docker services.
